name: Naisho no Kan'in ~Manatsu no Asedaku Koubi~
original_name: ナイショの姦淫～真夏の汗だく交尾～
source: The protagonist, Ootsuki Kenzou, loses his wife and becomes reclusive in his hometown due to his sense of loss. About a year later, the wives who were sent by his three sons start taking care of him selflessly, and he regains his vitality. However, at the same time, his sexual desire returns, and he becomes conscious of his daughters-in-law as women. He had been suppressing his sexual desire by masturbating, but one day he gets caught.
translation: 主人公大槻健三失去了妻子，因失落感而隐居在家乡。大约一年后，三个儿子派来的妻子开始无私地照顾他，他又恢复了活力。然而，与此同时，他的性欲又回来了，他开始意识到他的儿媳妇是女性。他一直通过自慰来压抑自己的性欲，但有一天他被抓了。
